snippet.title: Heat of Eleven 98 Let’s Play - 3DO M2 Konami - Video Game Esoterica - EP 13.2
snippet.description:
On this weeks episode of Video Game Esoterica we have a pretty big treat for you all....the first ever full playthrough of Heat of Eleven '98, a pretty impressive soccer game for the Konami / 3DO M2 platform! This game is rarer than rare and for once rare equals a good game!

Hope you guys enjoy. This game was a surprise for me...I expected it to be bad and I was pleasantly surprised just by how good it really was!

Thanks for watching! Questions? Comments? Leave them below and I will do my best to answer each and every one of them! You can follow us at Instagram @ChicagoGameCollector

See you all next week for more fun and new content!

VGE
